super6.race: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
super6.comment: In frame at Roscommon in June and August. Has now dropped below last winning mark for in-form yard and no surprise were he to fare better now down in grade and back up in trip, though the market is likely to prove the best guide as to expectations.

finals.race: Dudley Peverill Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Recorded a first hurdles win in Britain after 6 months off in 7-runner handicap at Stratford (19f, good to soft) in October and impressed in following up from a 6 lb higher mark at Huntingdon (2m) later in the month. Looks up to completing the hat-trick.

Expensive point recruit who has raced just 4 times under Rules. Showed much improved form sent chasing after 14 months off when second in listed mares event at Huntingdon in February before finding Grade 2 at Cheltenham Festival all too much. Off since and sights lowered slightly.

finals.race: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: All 5 career wins gained in small-field contests, latest of them when better than ever over 25f at Wincanton in April. Sound-enough third from 4 lb higher 3 weeks later and he's capable fresh. Yard also in good nick.

finals.race: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post And Win' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €56,000 3-y-o, No Risk At All gelding. Half-brother to 2 winners, including French 2¼m hurdle winner Alchimie. Dam 7f/7.5f winner abroad. Looked promising when making a successful debut in Newcastle bumper in April and obvious claims now going hurdling for a yard that is starting to hit top form.

finals.race: Arnold Thomson Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Bumper scorer who has quickly reached a fairly useful level over hurdles, winning his first 2 starts before his jumping became an issue in stronger company afterwards. Returns on the back of a breathing operation and built for chasing but he'll clearly need to jump fences better than he did hurdles.

finals.race: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Goliath Du Berlais gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including useful hurdler/smart chase winner Steel Ally and fairly useful 2m hurdle winner Next Twist. Has an appealing pedigree, so makes appeal on debut.
Veteran who added to a creditable record fresh when fourth at Carlisle 3 weeks ago but far from sure he will build on that.

Irish point winner who made a successful hurdling debut at Worcester last October. Failed to build last season but left his chasing debut form well behind tried in cheekpieces after 9 months off when second of 4 at Stratford recently. Respected with return to 3m promising to suit.

finals.race: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
finals.comment: Better than ever when winning 14-runner handicap at this C&D 12 days ago by 1¾ lengths from One Cool Bear, showing a good change of pace to lead over 1f out. Can go well again after 7 lb rise.

finals.race: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
finals.comment: Navan maiden winner on second start and stopped the slide to an extent after a poor start in handicaps when 3 lengths fifth of 14 to Jordan Breeze over this C&D (18/1) 12 days ago. Blinkers on first time.

finals.race: 'Play Coral Racing-Super-Series For Free' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Has got his act together over hurdles of late, his Bangor success well advertised while he got the hat-trick up at Hexham despite errors returning. Further 5 lb rise could be his undoing, though.

finals.race: BNG Made Easy With Reverte Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Completed quick hat-trick this time last year and following another breathing operation, returned to form when winning 8-runner event at Stratford (2¾m, good to firm) in September. Probably remained in form when third of 4 at Hereford (3¼m, good to firm) last month and yard are currently flying.

finals.race: Coral 'We're Here For It' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Veteran who took advantage of drop in the weights at Hexham in May. Held form well off revised mark since and is of interest again now having been eased 3 lb.

finals.race: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Median Auction Maiden
finals.comment: Ran at least as well as on debut when third of 21 in maiden at Navan (6f, good to soft) 5 weeks ago. Step up in trip a positive move and she could prove tough to beat.

finals.race: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Median Auction Maiden
finals.comment: Showed more than first time up when third of 12 in maiden at the Curragh (6f, soft) last month. Probably one for handicaps after this.

finals.race: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
finals.comment: Bounced back to form to register her first success of the campaign when landing 13-runner C&D handicap last week. Looks fairly treated by 5 lb rise based on last year's efforts and dangerous to dismiss.

finals.race: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
finals.comment: In frame at Roscommon in June and August. Has now dropped below last winning mark for in-form yard and no surprise were he to fare better now down in grade and back up in trip, though the market is likely to prove the best guide as to expectations.

finals.race: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
finals.comment: Seen to good effect when making all at Wexford on his fifth start in bumpers. Little show in trio of Flat maidens but likely capable of better now tackling a handicap. Worth a market check.
